title: Intellient: Collaborative AI Platform for the Enterprise | Quadra
description: Intellient is Quadra's collaborative AI platform that transforms complex enterprise problem-solving with contextual intelligence, AI-assisted decision-making, and intelligent workflow automation at scale.

blocks.text: Intellient: Collaborative AI for Complex Enterprise Problem-Solving

Traditional automation is task-driven and rigid. But your most complex business challenges—like supply-chain exceptions or compliance workflows—are goal-driven and require planning, coordination, and the collaboration of multiple experts

blocks.alt: woman wearing grey striped dress shirt sitting down near brown wooden table in front of white laptop computer
man in white dress shirt sitting beside woman in black long sleeve shirt

blocks.text: Intellient is Quadra’s proprietary platform for creating autonomous, multi-agent AI systems. Built on cutting-edge frameworks like Microsoft AutoGen, we architect teams of specialized AI agents that can work together, and with your human experts, to orchestrate knowledge work and solve dynamic, multi-step problems.
Design and deploy teams of AI agents that can plan, delegate, and execute complex tasks.
Create seamless workflows where AI agents assist, and are guided by, your human experts.
Securely connect agentic systems to your core business platforms and data sources.
Move beyond simple RPA to build intelligent systems that can adapt and reason to achieve a desired business outcome
